name: FedEx Express Regional Hub - Fort Worth TX
type: Express regional hub (Fort Worth Alliance Airport)

fieldNotes.siteConfirmation: Roster address (2851 Alliance Gateway Fwy) was RANGE_INTERPOLATED onto a residential block ~3 km south of the actual hub - the supplied coords were wrong. Web research established the FedEx Express Fort Worth Hub is at 2001 World Wide Dr, on the east cargo apron of Perot Field / Fort Worth Alliance Airport. Satellite confirmed a large white-roofed sort building with aircraft at airside positions, a second large sort/cross-dock building, an office building, and an extensive ULD/trailer drop yard. Locked center 32.99465, -97.31290. FedEx Express opened the Fort Worth Hub in 1997; ~600,000 sq ft, 800+ employees, ~100,000 packages/day on two sorts, ~650 flights/month.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Z20 satellite at 32.9921,-97.3092 shows a controlled checkpoint where the public access road enters the hub: a small guard booth flanked by sliding gates, perimeter fencing, and lane striping. Street View (2016/2021 panos) confirms a manned gate with a green-windowed guard booth, an overhead gate canopy/barrier frame, multiple in/out lanes, and a 'FedEx Security' sign on the booth. Definitive controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Street View clearly shows a small 1-vehicle-footprint booth with windows on multiple sides beside the entrance lane, signed for FedEx Security - a staffed guard shack.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - entrance is staffed, not kiosk/call-box only.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Wide paved apron outside the gate on the public access road provides truck queue/staging room before the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved area inside the gate between the checkpoint and the dock/ramp area allows trucks to hold before docking.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The gate-to-dock approach is long and wide - easily holds a queue of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Gate apron is wide with multiple striped lanes and unused paved width - physical room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Truck/road-feeder docks line the south (second) building face; trailers seen backed in. Door count estimated in the 25-50 band from overhead imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Z20 imagery between the buildings shows dozens of trailers/ULD containers parked in long rows in a dedicated drop yard - well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has the main sort building, a second large sort/cross-dock building, an office building, and support structures - a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer/container storage lot full of parked trailers between the two main buildings.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Hub operation (air-to-ground sort); docks are not split into clearly separate ship vs receive banks on different faces - judged false.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh platform observed in the truck path.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; airside cargo facility.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box approximates the core landside hub footprint (buildings + drop yard + gate apron); ~95 acres is an estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Street View shows multiple striped lanes through the checkpoint; ~2 inbound / 2 outbound estimated, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the AllianceTexas industrial development at a major-metro airport (DFW); Urban.

citations.claim: Active FedEx sort/handler reqs at Fort Worth corroborate the Southwest Regional Hub at Perot Field/Alliance

verification.rationale: FedEx Express Southwest Regional Hub at Alliance, ~800 staff 24/7; no closure signal.
